findings.reason: After the change, `--clone <slug>` is dropped without any message, like any unknown flag. Someone with an old command (`npx claude4spec --clone foo` in an empty dir) now gets a workspace-only start: no project is created and the browser opens /welcome. Nothing says the flag was removed. Printing a one-line 'unknown/removed flag --clone ignored' warning (not an alias) would make the removal visible. The parser has no unknown-flag handling at all, so this is optional polish, not a regression.
